why: map, filter and reduce are the composable operator core (Fold→Fold, FoldSet→FoldSet, FoldSet→Fold) and graph-transition is what makes data/unfold-graph.gml addressable. None of them exists as a repo authority yet: the phase surface is owned by data/grammar/kuhul.runtime-grammar.ebnf plus data/drivers/phases/*.json, and the fold structure by data/grammar/foldgraph.ebnf. This contract binds the four operator grammars to those existing authorities instead of publishing a second, competing copy of the phase or fold grammar.

algebra.law: the three operators compose; none of them admits, and the composition still needs XCFE admission before anything executes
algebra.type_safety: each operator preserves the carrier kind: map maps one fold to one fold, filter yields a subset of its input set, reduce yields exactly one fold

determinism.law: every operator declares a determinism mode; a non-deterministic mode must record what makes it reproducible

reduce.float_note: a float sum is not associative, so sum over a float carrier declares order_sensitive: true even though the mathematical sum is associative
reduce.source_immutability: reduce never mutates its source folds; it produces a new fold carrying the aggregated result
reduce.empty_set: reduce over an empty set yields the declared initial value, which is why initial is not optional
reduce.algebra_reference: data/grammar/kuhul-fold-algebra.contracts.json declares REDUCE as the reducer family; this contract declares the accumulator semantics the reducer implements

movement.terminal_scope: terminality is scoped to ONE execution: Xul ends it, and the Xul→Pop edge is the boundary that starts the next one
movement.phase_identity: Chen / Ch_en / Ch'en are one phase, canonicalised at the parser boundary (world::canonical_phase_name)

trace.law: operators declare and are recorded; no recorded dispatch admits or commits, and no trace field may be read as OA6 authorization

fields.xcfe: one {op, admitted, authority, dispatch} per operator node
fields.steps: the ordered operator and phase events

invariants.OA1: map, filter and reduce each declare their declared type signature and the composition Reduce(Filter(Map(F))) is stated
invariants.OA2: no operator grammar redefines the phase surface or the fold structure; those stay owned by the runtime grammar, the phase drivers and foldgraph.ebnf
invariants.OA3: every operator declares a determinism mode, and a non-deterministic mode names what makes it reproducible
invariants.OA4: reduce requires an initial value, declares which accumulators are order independent, and never mutates its sources
invariants.OA5: a movement declares its guard (hamming distance 1 for semantic, |Δphase| = 1 with forward-only inside an execution for phase) and its admission owner
invariants.OA6: no operator and no transition may write topology; only a verified, XCFE-authorized Xul commits
